title: Flow sequences as implicit keys on two lines
notes: An implicit key may be a flow collection on one line (productions 154 and 155, with a flow collection as the key node, and 193 in a block mapping). A block mapping may hold several such entries, each on its own line at the same indentation.

provenance.reference: Differential testing of the oneyaml-python native and pure backends; the pure parser rejected the second entry at 2:1 with a mapping key expected.
